title: Resume externally-staged VICE .vsf snapshots in the native oracle
body: The native VICE oracle (vice_x64 shim) reads and resumes a .vsf snapshot staged by a standalone x64sc, including snapshots from an older VICE release whose module versions differ from the bundled submodule, so lockstep can start from a user-supplied known state (C64SC identity, reSID engine, true-drive set).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A supplied x64sc PAL/C64C .vsf (tests/ViceSharp.TestHarness/Fixtures/Vsf/ready-c64sc-truedrive.vsf) loads with rc=0 and snapshot_last_error=0; all 16 C64 modules (MAINCPU..USERPORT) are consumed.
The resumed MAINCPU registers (A/X/Y/SP/PC) equal those encoded in the snapshot's MAINCPU module.
No regression to the reSID lockstep timing gate or SID parity (X64ScVariantLockstep 306 pass / 0 fail / 1 skip; SID parity 8/8).
